data_description.cool_hysteresis: Temperature deadband around the setpoint used when estimating whether the compressor is running (drives the cooling/idle status). 0 disables the deadband.
data_description.compressor_off_delay: How long the room must stay below the setpoint before the status flips from cooling to idle. Models compressor run-on and avoids flapping near the setpoint.
